# StegVerse Core-Lite Ingestion Pipeline
# Minimal footprint: telemetry + basic governance only
# No entity bridge, no cost accounting, no deterministic gates
# Version: 0.3.0-lite

name: stegverse-ingest-lite
version: 0.3.0-lite

triggers:
  - webhook: /ingest
  - queue: stegverse-ingest-queue

steps:
  1_validate:
    action: validate_input
    schema: stegverse-input-lite
    reject_on_fail: true

  2_auth:
    action: tvc_authenticate
    source: TrustVaultController
    ephemeral: true
    lifetime: 300

  3_classify:
    action: classify_payload
    routes:
      - telemetry → stegdb_telemetry
      - governance_check → governance_core

  4_log:
    action: stegdb_write
    table: "{{org}}_ingestion_log"
    org_segregated: true

  5_emit:
    action: route_to_core
    target: [telemetry, governance]
